prompt: Close-up of hot mushroom goulash in a plain white deep plate, a golden onion flatbread resting on the plate rim. Camera 45° above, food filling the frame. Glossy dark reddish-brown sauce, starch-thickened, coating halved and quartered brown button mushrooms with slightly shrivelled medium-brown glossy caps and pale cut faces; chunks of king oyster mushroom with thick ivory-white stems and golden-brown seared cut surfaces; soft halved pearl onions, translucent ivory with golden edges; small saturated-orange carrot dice. Fine bright-green chive rings scattered on top. The round yeast flatbread, about 1 cm thick, baked golden-brown with finger dimples, topped with softened caramelised red onion rings, dark olive-green rosemary needles and melted golden flecks of vegan hard cheese, one edge torn open. Gentle steam, clean plate rim, natural sheen, warm soft side light, 85 mm, f/5.6, true-to-life colours, sharp textures, blurred table, professional food photo.

visible_ingredients.real_life_appearance: Halved or quartered brown button mushrooms: smooth, medium-brown, glossy caps, slightly darker and a little shrivelled from searing and 15 minutes braising; cut faces show pale beige gills and cream-coloured flesh; caps stay intact but are soft, coated in sauce; about 8-10 pieces per portion.

King oyster mushrooms halved or quartered lengthwise: thick, meaty stems of creamy ivory-white with a small tan-brown cap; cut faces golden-brown and slightly crusted from searing, flesh stays pale ivory and firm after braising; clearly thicker and paler than the button mushrooms; about 3-4 chunks per portion.
Small pearl onions, peeled and halved, each half about 1-1.5 cm; after sautéing and braising the layers are soft, translucent ivory-white with golden edges, no bite left; about 6 halves per portion.
Peeled carrots cut into small dice about 0.5-0.8 cm; soft after braising but still recognisable as cubes, saturated orange with a glossy sheen from the sauce.

Dark reddish-brown sauce from beer, soy and teriyaki sauce, deepened by paprika; glossy and starch-thickened so it coats each piece like a glaze - spoonable and clinging, not a thin soup; mustard adds a slight sheen, no graininess.
Fresh chives cut into fine, thin bright green rings 2-3 mm long, scattered raw over the finished goulash; visibly fresher and lighter green than everything else.

Round yeast flatbread about 12-15 cm across, rolled to about 1 cm thick; baked 20-25 minutes so the top is light golden-brown with shallow finger dimples, the thin rim crisp and deeply golden, the crumb soft and pale.
Red onion rings separated into thin loops, baked soft; mostly translucent golden-brown with caramelised darker edges and only a faint purple tinge left in places; sunk into the dimpled surface.
Tiny dark olive-green needle-like rosemary leaves scattered sparsely over the flatbread, slightly crisped and dry-looking from the oven.
Finely grated vegan hard cheese baked onto the flatbread: melted into small pale golden flecks with lightly crisped edges, not a stretchy melted layer like dairy cheese.
